PROGRESS NOTE

The patient is seen today for a first cardiology visit after establishing care at this
institution; prior records from the outside hospital where the original valve procedure
was performed are not yet available.

History: The patient reports having undergone transcatheter aortic valve replacement
approximately four years ago at another facility, with no clear documentation available
of the immediate post-procedure echocardiographic baseline.

Today's Echocardiogram: The prosthetic transcatheter valve leaflets appear thickened, and
the mean gradient is 24 mmHg. Mild paravalvular regurgitation is present. Because no prior
echocardiogram is available in this record for direct comparison, the significance of this
gradient relative to the patient's own post-implant baseline cannot be determined at this
visit.

Plan: Attempt to obtain outside records including the original post-implant echocardiogram
for comparison. Repeat echocardiography in six months.
